cells.gaps: No source found names a body set up or named to carry out the strategy: the Responsible AI Office it proposes is not yet set up. The US$20 million announced at the April 2026 launch awaited release in September 2026, so no money allocated has been found. The Vice President spoke in November 2026 of developing a strategy (GHA-046); the many dated reports of its approval and launch stand.
cells.note: Approved by Cabinet in February 2026 and launched in April 2026, so stage 3; reassessed 2026-11-05 on the Vice President's remark, which does not say the strategy is unadopted. No body named to carry it out has been found, so stage 4 is not met.
